name: Your step: Send one FBA fee pilot pitch
description: One manually sent business pitch. Glacier does not browse for prospects or send email.
goal: Let Benjamin manually test the $49 CSV fee variance pilot with one qualified business prospect.

config.prompt: Your step: choose one prospect in ventures/fba-fee-check/prospects.csv, confirm that it is a business you may contact and that current FBA use is qualified, then manually send the pitch from PILOT.md. Fill in your true reply-to email and business mailing address and include the opt-out sentence. Do not use an automated sender, scrape a site, or ask for Amazon credentials or reports by email. Glacier does not send anything. Record that the manual pitch was sent or dismiss this step.
